evals.name: qahwa-admin
evals.prompt: Here's our admin dashboard and our brand file. Run a brand audit and make the dashboard fully on-brand: colours in the right proportion, our fonts, icons that match, our voice (work with the UX writer on copy), and the chart. Keep every interaction working.
evals.expected_output: Bricolage Grotesque everywhere, 70/20/10 within tolerance with semantic colours intact, one icon spec, voice fixes from a UX Writer exchange, brand chart palette, interactions intact, report with brand score.

evals.name: vibe-dashboard
evals.prompt: apply our brand to this dashboard please (brand file attached) - fonts, colours, icons, tone, and make the chart match. same data
evals.expected_output: Brand fonts, palette by role with semantic statuses kept, consistent icons, on-voice copy, brand chart colours, same 10 subscribers and numbers.
